variants.headline: Looking back: business-start grant programme ends
variants.sub: Business-starting support under {programme} has come to an end.
variants.body:
We return to our earlier coverage. Our report recorded this: The grant programme {programme} for people starting a business had ended.

The programme has ended. It leaves a count of grants paid and applications refused, not a tidy tale in which every ending explains itself. Readers can ask whether the support was worthwhile without turning a programme's closing notice into a made-up story about every person who applied.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

The responsibility of {target} should be examined against the programme's recorded payments and refusals. Its conclusion is established, while the merits of individual outcomes require more than the fact of closure alone.
